David Morehouse was an Army officer assigned to the military's remote viewing program, known by names including Stargate, and he wrote the insider account of that work. With Danny Jones, the man billed as the Stargate physicist's colleague in that world unmasks what he calls the Pentagon's most disturbing black project, drawing on his years as a psychic soldier.

Morehouse describes sessions, targets, and the program's strange successes as he experienced them, along with the personal cost that ended his Army career. The remote viewing program is documented fact; its results remain disputed by the agencies that funded and then closed it. The episode preserves a participant's fullest telling. Listeners can compare his memory against the declassified evaluations, which is exactly the exercise this witness invites.
podcast-joerogan-aPbU2mPRY2I:
Comedian Neal Brennan tells Rogan his ayahuasca story in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Brennan, a co-creator of Chappelle's Show, turned to the Amazonian brew while fighting a stubborn depression. His telling is raw and funny in the same breath, a confessional with jokes left in.

He walks through the ceremony: the terror as the brew took hold, the visions, and the shift he felt in the weeks after. Rogan asks whether the change held and what it cost him to get there. The segment is one of the show's most human drug stories, because the stakes were not adventure but relief.
podcast-joerogan-cqefo5DwA2I:
Physicist Michio Kaku explains quantum computing and AI chatbots in this Joe Rogan Experience segment. Kaku, a City College professor and popular science author, has a gift for touring tomorrow's machines in plain words. Here the future gets explained one breakthrough at a time.

Kaku describes how quantum computers use the strangeness of atoms to solve problems no normal machine can touch. He weighs what chatbots really are and where true machine minds may lead. Rogan asks about risks, from hacked security to lost jobs. Curious and tech-struck listeners get a friendly guide to a strange new era.
